description: Permanently revoke the API key (or connection) this server is using right now, and only that one: a key cannot revoke any other. Use it when the user is finished with this key, or it may have leaked. After it succeeds every tool here stops working until a new key is configured. A key used by an OAuth-connected app (ChatGPT, Claude) disconnects that app. On a connection someone shared with the user (a site share), this gives that access back and the owner is emailed. Confirm with the user first; `confirm` must be "revoke". Other keys are managed at https://porkbun.com/account/api.

dry_run.description: Show which key would be revoked, without revoking it.

name: revoke_api_key
title: Revoke API Key
